verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no deduplication or grouping. Instead, Better Stack offers a mitigation: when 10–30 incidents are created at once, the on-call person can acknowledge them all with a single tap to stop the phone ringing. Escalation policies also notify the current on-call person first, so one human is paged initially. However, the copy itself says many separate incidents are still created, so related alerts are not collapsed into one incident. Missing for 10: documented alert deduplication, grouping or correlation of related alerts into a single incident, configurable grouping rules or windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
